data.one_liner: Provides locale code to name mappings for 563 locales in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It enables obtaining localized locale names from locale codes using a LocalizationsDelegate. It also provides sorted lists of locale codes and native locale names.
use_when: You need to display human-readable names for locale codes in your Flutter app.
You want translations of locale names based on the current app locale with a fallback option.
avoid_when: You do not need locale code translations or only require standard date/number formatting from intl.
strengths: Supports 563 locales out of the box.
Provides a straightforward LocalizationsDelegate for MaterialApp and CupertinoApp.
weaknesses: Sorting by name does not respect the locale because Flutter lacks string collation API.
data.setup_notes: Add LocaleNamesLocalizationsDelegate to your app's localizationsDelegates.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general internationalization, date/number formatting, and plurals.
